Package com.esignal.jstandard.event

Purpose of this package is to define all the event, listeners and adapter interfaces/objects for the JStandard API.

See: Description

  • Interface Summary 
    Interface Description
    AnalyticsRequestListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process the data objects for RESPONSE events.
    AuthTokenListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process AuthTokens returned back.
    ConnectionListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process events while establishing and closing connections.
    ContentRequestListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process the data objects for RESPONSE events.
    HistoricalBarListener
    The main purpose of this interface is to allow customers to write custom code to process HistoricalBars from HistoricalBarEvent , and FlexData from HistoricalBarFlexEvent.
    HistoricalTickListener
    The main purpose of this interface is to allow customers to write custom code to process HistoricalBars of intraday data, HistoricalTickRecord of tick data, HistoricalTickRecordCID of tick CID data objects and FlexData of Flex tick and bar data.
    MarketDepthListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process MarketDepth objects for UPDATE events.
    NewsListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process news for UPDATE events.
    NewsRequestListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process News returned back in the onResponse callback.
    OptionMonthsListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process Option Month String objects for UPDATE events.
    QuoteKeyListener
    Purpose of the listener is to send back symbols information while search it using QuoteManager.keyLookup(String, com.esignal.jstandard.beans.quote.LOOKUPTYPE, QuoteKeyListener)
    QuoteListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process quotes for UPDATE events.
    QuoteRequestListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process Quotes returned back.
    StatusEnum<T extends java.lang.Enum<?>>
    Some of these method has to be implemented for every enum since enums cannot be extended.
    StockOptionRootsListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process Quote objects for RESPONSE events.
    TriggeredQuoteEventListener
    The main purpose of this client implemented listener is to process addTrigger, removeTrigger and quotes for UPDATE events for the TriggeredQuoteEventManager.

    Class Description
    AnalyticsEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the AnalyticsEvent related data.
    AuthTokenEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the Authentication related data.
    BarEvent

    Purpose of this abstract class is to provide empty method implementation for ConnectionListener.

    Purpose of this class is to hold the ConnectionEvent related data.
    ContentEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the ContentEvent related data.
    DictionaryEvent
    This class holds dictionary related information such as version, flags bitmap, a boolean to signify if this is a full dictionary or a update, and the dictionary string containing Flex data fields and related information for that dictionary version.
    HeadlineEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the Headlines related data.
    HistoricalBarEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the HistoricalBarEvent related data.
    HistoricalBarFlexEvent
    The purpose of this class is to hold the HistoricalBarFlexEvent related data.
    HistoricalTickEvent<T>
    Purpose of this class is to hold the HistoricalTickEvent related data.
    HistoricalTickFlexEvent
    The purpose of this class is to hold the HistoricalTickFlexEvent related data.
    KeyLookupEvent
    This event will contain the information while looking up for symbols with keys like CUSIP, SEDOL etc.
    MarketDepthEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the MarketDepthEvent related data.
    MarketDepthInfoEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the MarketDepthInfoEvent related data.
    NetOrderImbalanceEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the NetOrderImbalanceEvent related data.
    OptionMonthsEvent
    Purpose of this event is to hold Months info that the option is being traded on.
    QuoteEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the QuoteEvent related data.
    StatusEvent
    StatusEvent was introduced in order to provide status codes and descriptions.
    StockOptionRootsEvent
    Purpose of this event is to hold Stock Option Roots Quote information.
    StoryEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the News Story related data.
    SymbolEvent
    Purpose of this event is to work as a base event which returns back data to the client for a given symbol.
    TickEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the HistoricalTickEvent related data.
    TriggeredQuoteEvent
    Purpose of this class is to hold the name of the trigger and the status related data.
